set -e
cat > /etc/init.d/inventory-worker <<'ANTRIEB_INIT_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
### BEGIN INIT INFO
# Provides:          inventory-worker
# Required-Start:    $remote_fs
# Required-Stop:     $remote_fs
# Default-Start:     2 3 4 5
# Default-Stop:      0 1 6
# Short-Description: Confined inventory background worker
### END INIT INFO

PATH=/sbin:/usr/sbin:/bin:/usr/bin
NAME=inventory-worker
ROOT=/srv/inventory-worker
DAEMON=/bin/inventory-worker
PIDFILE=/var/run/inventory-worker.pid
CHUID=105:112

is_running() {
    [ -r "$PIDFILE" ] || return 1
    PID=`cat "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null` || return 1
    [ -n "$PID" ] || return 1
    kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null
}

case "$1" in
    start)
        if is_running; then
            echo "$NAME already running"
            exit 0
        fi
        rm -f "$PIDFILE"
        echo "Starting $NAME"
        start-stop-daemon --start --quiet --pidfile "$PIDFILE" \
            --chroot "$ROOT" --chdir /var/lib/inventory \
            --chuid "$CHUID" --background --make-pidfile \
            --startas "$DAEMON" --
        ;;
    stop)
        echo "Stopping $NAME"
        start-stop-daemon --stop --quiet --retry TERM/10/KILL/5 \
            --pidfile "$PIDFILE" --oknodo
        rm -f "$PIDFILE"
        ;;
    restart|force-reload)
        "$0" stop
        "$0" start
        ;;
    status)
        if is_running; then
            echo "$NAME is running (pid `cat "$PIDFILE"`)"
            exit 0
        fi
        echo "$NAME is not running"
        exit 3
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: $0 {start|stop|restart|force-reload|status}" >&2
        exit 2
        ;;
esac
exit 0
ANTRIEB_INIT_EOF
